title: Quest. 77. Is it lawful to Pray in the Church without a prescribed or premeditated form of Words?

segments.text: Answ. THere are so few sober and serious Christians that ever made a doubt of this, that I will not bestow many words to prove it.
1. That which is not forbidden is lawful. But Church-prayer without a premeditated or prescribed form of words is not forbidden (by God) Therefore (as to Gods Laws) it is not unlawful.

2. To express holy desires understandingly, orderly, seriously and in apt expressions, is lawfull praying. But all this may be done without a set form of words; Therefore to pray without a set form of words may be lawful.
3. The Consent of the Universal Church, and the experience of godly men, are arguments so strong, as are not to be made light of.
4. To which Scripture instances may be added.
